Keycloak.//: the realm of the Keycloak in ../keycloak; KEYCLOAK_ISSUER and KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET override issuer and secret

Receiver.//: TransmitterIssuer and OAuth2 are derived from the Keycloak settings in Program.cs

Stream.//: the application registers its own PUSH stream on startup, Keycloak assigns the audience

Push.//: how Keycloak (in Docker) reaches the push endpoint, must be allowed by 'ssf.validPushUrls' of the client; SSF_PUSH_URL overrides it

Revocation.//: which events end sessions (alias or event type URI, these are the defaults); Keycloak only delivers the events the stream requested. SessionEventTypes end the session named by the event, or all sessions of the user if it names none; UserEventTypes end all sessions of the user. The TTL must cover the cookie lifetime.
